recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future work changes ConceptMap relationship semantics, handle it in the current ConceptMapRelationship code system, bindings, and ConceptMap.relationship source rather than in retired DSTU2 equivalence artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-12133 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 FHIR-I issue saying the required ConceptMap equivalence value set was problematic for maps whose equivalence had not been asserted, and requesting a parent concept 'related to' for equal/equivalent/narrower/wider/inexact mappings. The Jira resolution says the work was already done on a different task.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12133. The same change was applied through FHIR-11279 in git-svn revision 9925, commit b11f1f4131d2c977cef30cb82e26399fad2ecedc, which added relatedto to ConceptMapEquivalence and made existing equivalence codes children of it. FHIR-10437 records the same Mayo request and was also resolved as already done under another task.
additional_context: Later R5 ConceptMap decisions changed the model rather than undoing the seed request: FHIR-22632 replaced target.equivalence/ConceptMapEquivalence with target.relationship/ConceptMapRelationship, and FHIR-25923 finalized directional source-is-narrower/source-is-broader code names. The current source retains related-to as the general parent in the active ConceptMapRelationship code list and uses required bindings to ValueSet/concept-map-relationship. Related issues FHIR-10437, FHIR-11279, FHIR-22632, and FHIR-25923 already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active ConceptMap resource and terminology source already express the needed semantics, and resurrecting or editing retired ConceptMapEquivalence artifacts would not be a current-spec fix.
